description: Update the `disable_plugins` configuration parameter to accept Plugin class types instead of strings, making it consistent with the existing `plugins` parameter. Maintain backward compatibility by accepting strings at runtime with a deprecation warning, and ensure environment variable support continues to work through updated interpreter logic.
functional_requirements: Change the type annotation for `disable_plugins` from `list[str]` to `list[type[Plugin]]` in the configuration system
Implement runtime normalization that converts string plugin names to their corresponding Plugin classes, issuing a deprecation warning when strings are used
Update the environment variable interpreter to resolve Plugin classes from string values, reusing this logic where appropriate to avoid duplication
Ensure the REFLEX_DISABLE_PLUGINS environment variable continues to function correctly with the new type system
